message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Biome Format and linter check
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]

jobs:
  biome:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run Biome
        run: yarn lint",
  "rationale": "The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern bounds jobs with an explicit timeout to reduce runaway consumption, and the measured experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 shows adding timeout-minutes: 5 preserved all checks while cutting median elapsed time (~26.8%). The repository's CI history shows every recent biome run succeeds in roughly 1-2 minutes, so a 5-minute budget gives operational headroom without endangering valid runs. Only timeout-minutes: 5 is added; all checkout, setup, install, and lint steps are unchanged, so build/test coverage is preserved and no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions are introduced.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
